text.tspan: Stated on the scale that pipelines report
Subtracting one position offset c from a single-order win rate leaves error e(v) =
½Δ(v) − c. Whatever c is, the verbose-versus-terse contrast is off by exactly half
the interaction. Swap-averaging and length-stratified correction are exact.
Judging stimulus k in all four (slot, length) cells makes its
difference-in-differences unbiased for its interaction. The stimulus's unknown
quality gap enters every cell and cancels.
Counting a tie as a vote for slot B is not swap-equivariant. It adds the fall in tie
rate under lengthening to the estimate, and it makes a position-invariant judge
An additive log-odds judge still shows win-rate interaction near the ceiling, but
only through a position main effect. We estimate this baseline per judge and test
